pilot-blue.note: Focus, links, slider outputs, undo links, brand-dot glow only. NEVER an action fill under white text (fails AA).

pilot-blue-deep.note: The working end of the accent: dropdown borders, wheel-segment hover fill, hotkey chip border, selection tint under non-text UI.

accent-deep.note: AA-verified action fill: primary button, active tab, hovered combo row, hovered icon cell. White text clears 4.5:1. Derivation by computeChrome deepens any theme accent until this clears — sacred, not overridable.

accent-deep-hi.note: The hover step of Accent Deep. The deeper→lighter order is preserved; hover never jumps to full Pilot Blue under white text.

midnight.note: App canvas behind everything — the bottom of the tonal ramp.

panel.note: Sidebar and preview-bay chrome — one step up from canvas.

card.note: Content containers and segment rows; carries the quiet card sheen.

field-bg.note: Inputs, selects, dropdown body, inline code — the deepest interactive well, carved with an inner top shadow.

btn-bg.note: Secondary button, chip, and toast fill; carries the machined sheen.

ink-muted.note: Labels, hints, secondary values. #8fa3b5 on #161f29 is the AA floor — nothing milder ships.

danger.note: Destructive buttons and error banners; destructive actions recede, they don't shout.

err-bg.note: Error-banner fill, paired with Signal Red border and light-red Error Ink text.

code-ink.note: Text color for Consolas machine-truth chips (paths, inline code) on the Field Well.

on-accent.note: The only text color permitted on accent-deep action fills.

hover-well.note: Wash under a hovered segment-list row.

edit-well.note: The expanded per-segment editor hangs below its row on this fill.

tab-hover-well.note: Hover wash on sidebar tab buttons.

scroll-thumb.note: Switch-off track and slider trough; also the sidecar switch token. Scrollbar thumbs use white-at-14% (rgba(255,255,255,.14)).

preview-well-hi.note: Center stop of the live-preview bay's radial-gradient well.

preview-well-lo.note: Outer stop (75%) of the preview well; the bay carries a lit inner lip (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04)).

panel-vibrant.note: Win11 22H2+ only, gated on <html data-vibrant> inside @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: no-preference). Sidebar and preview bay float on real DWM acrylic over this translucent tint. Chrome only — never content, floating layers, or the wheel.

content-vibrant.note: The content field under vibrancy: near-opaque, never translucent enough to read the desktop through.

focus-halo.note: The 3px ring around a focused input, painted together with the accent border step — one state, both properties.

rim-highlight.note: The 1px lit rim on the wheel's outer edge.

wheel-stroke.note: 1px edge stroke on every segment plate.

ring-inner.note: Config-owned wheel plate (themes.mjs roles ring1). Darker toward the hub, lighter per ring step.

wheel-center.note: Hub disc; stroked in the theme accent at 22% opacity, 1.5px.

headline.purpose: Tab titles in the Settings content header only — the iOS large-title cadence (700, 22px, −0.4px tracking).

title.purpose: Sidebar brand wordmark (700, 17px, +0.3px); ring section heads step down at 15px/700/−0.2px.

body.purpose: Base UI voice (400, 13.5px); buttons inherit it.

caption.purpose: Smallest Segoe role (400, 11px): chip text, combo categories, save-state.

micro-mono.purpose: Consolas 10.5px — combo paths, smallest machine truth.

mono.purpose: Consolas 12px — segment target values, inline code, file paths. Anything machine-real renders mono.

icon-row.purpose: Segoe Fluent Icons at 19px — segment-row glyphs.

icon-picker.purpose: Segoe Fluent Icons at 22px — the icon-modal grid.

shadows.name: wheel-drop
shadows.value: SVG feDropShadow dx=0 dy=6 stdDeviation=14 flood-color rgba(0,0,0,0.55)
shadows.purpose: The entire wheel floats over the desktop on this single deep diffuse drop.

shadows.name: float-high
shadows.purpose: Dropdown/combo lists, the icon-picker modal, and modal cards — highest layer. Light-mode cadence softens to rgba(0,0,0,.22).

shadows.name: float-low
shadows.purpose: Toasts and ephemeral notices. Light mode: rgba(0,0,0,.16).

shadows.name: pilot-glow
shadows.purpose: Brand dot only — the one permitted glow in the system (No-Glow Rule).

shadows.name: carved-well
shadows.purpose: Inputs, selects, and the hotkey chip read as pressed into their surface. Light mode softens to rgba(0,0,0,.10).

shadows.name: switch-track-well
shadows.purpose: The checkbox-as-switch track: the same carved-well cadence at a hair less depth, so the 28x16 pill reads pressed without competing with full inputs.

shadows.name: machined-sheen
shadows.purpose: Top-down light on solid matter: buttons and interactive fills. Depth from light, never from glow. Light mode raises to .55.

shadows.name: machined-sheen-quiet
shadows.purpose: The whisper of top light on cards and preset chips. Light mode .35.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Painted with the accent border step on input focus — one state, both properties.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: Only full-viewport translucency in the system. Light mode: rgba(240,242,245,.62).

shadows.name: knob-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lift under the two white circular controls — the only shadows on rest-state controls.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The Apple-cadence default easing (--ease-out) for every Settings transition; no overshoot outside the wheel.

motion.name: wheel-pop
motion.value: @keyframes wheelpop: scale(0.86) opacity(0) -> 60% opacity 1 -> scale(1), duration animationMs (default 160, user-tunable 0-400) on cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)
motion.purpose: Summon entrance on the live overlay only — never in the preview, never when animationMs is 0, never under prefers-reduced-motion (wheel-core.js).

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Segment hover nudge: translate 3px outward along its radius (--tx/--ty). The only overshoot curves in the system, and they belong to the wheel alone (Snap-Back Rule).

motion.name: dim-others
motion.purpose: Non-hovered segments recede when any segment is hovered; the lifted segment's icon gets brightness(1.18) — no glow.

motion.name: fade-state
motion.purpose: State changes on segments, hub, tabs, buttons.

motion.name: press-sink
motion.purpose: Button and tab press — a quiet sink, never a bounce. Preset chips sink to scale(.97).

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entrance; pairs with the undo affordance.

motion.name: thumb-lift
motion.value: slider thumb transform scale(1.08) on hover, scale(1.14) on active, .1s var(--ease-out)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): wheel transitions off, hover nudge dropped, pop skipped in JS; settings toast/modal/combo animations and all transitions disabled, press sinks neutralized
motion.purpose: Both surfaces carry a required alternative; hover fill + hub report keep the affordance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single confirming action per view. Accent Deep fill under the machined sheen; hover steps to Accent Deep Hi — never full Pilot Blue under white text (AA).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07), rgba(255,255,255,0) 45%), #2768b5; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2768b5; padding: 7px 13px; font: 400 13px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.25,1), border-color .12s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.25,1), transform .1s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.25,1), filter .1s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.25,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07), rgba(255,255,255,0) 45%), #2b73c6; border-color: #2b73c6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.985); filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c9ff0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default control: Browse, Export, row actions. Danger variant keeps this machined body with Signal Red text and a red hover border — destructive actions recede. Small (3px 9px) and mini (2px 7px, 6px radius) scales exist.

components.name: Text Input / Select
components.description: Field-well input carved with an inner top shadow; focus is the accent border step plus the 3px Focus Halo as one state.

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Left-rail navigation (210px rail): muted ink at rest, tab-hover-well wash with full ink on hover, Accent Deep + quiet sheen + lit top inset when active. Exactly one active item; the accent appears once.

components.name: Settings Card

components.name: The Radial Wheel (signature)
components.description: Hero component; one shared renderer (wheel-core.js) for overlay and Settings preview. Annular sectors on two tinted plates under a single machined-light pass: off-center specular wash (white 6% at upper-left), 1px white-at-8% rim, lit hub crown, hub stroked accent at 22%. Hover: others dim to 55%, active segment nudges 3px outward on the spring with icon brightness 1.18 — no glow — while the hub reports icon and label.
components.css: .ds-wheel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 260px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #17202a, #0b1015 75%); border: 1px solid #21303e; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04); filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.55)); } .ds-segs path { transition: opacity .12s ease, fill .1s ease; } .ds-segs path:hover { fill: #2e7dd1; }

narrative.overview: An Apple-inspired physical system. Every surface reads as real material on a dark desk: machined edges lit from above, controls that press, a dial that springs under the finger. Depth comes from light and shadow on solid matter, never from glow. Machined midnight hardware: the Settings window is a well-built instrument panel — three deliberate columns, dense but breathable rows, hairline seams instead of decoration. The wheel itself is the product's hero object: a two-ring dial of tinted metal plates at the cursor, popping in with weight and springing under hover. Color is nearly absent from the chrome and precisely present where it means something — Pilot Blue for the thing you're about to act on.
keyCharacteristics: One family, five weights: Segoe UI carries everything; Segoe Fluent Icons is the only pictographic voice; Consolas marks machine truth (paths, values, code).
Tonal midnight ramp (bg → panel → card → field) with hairline borders; shadows reserved exclusively for floating objects.
On Windows 11 the sidebar and preview bay float on real DWM acrylic; everywhere else they keep the solid Panel step.

Machined light discipline: buttons and cards carry a whisper of top-down sheen, inputs are carved with an inner shadow, and the wheel gets an off-center specular wash, a lit rim, and a crowned hub — Apple hardware lighting, never glow.
A single accent — Pilot Blue — speaking for selection, focus, and primary action.
Motion with physics: the wheel's 160 ms pop and spring-hover overshoot are the system's signature; everything else is ease-out under 200 ms, and press feedback is a quiet sink, never a bounce.
Radius and padding steps are small and consistent; nothing is more decorative than its function.

rules.name: The Pilot Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only where a user action is being invited, taken, or focused — primary buttons, active tab, focus rings, hover fills, slider outputs. It never decorates inactive content. Its rarity is what makes it read as "live."

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: The only permitted glow in the system is the 10px brand dot beside the sidebar title. Neon halos, acrylic blur frames, and illuminated edges — the gamer-HUD reflex — are banned outright.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI carries every text role; no second UI typeface enters Settings. Hierarchy is weight and size only, at a tight 1.12–1.2 step ratio — no display posturing inside a tool.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be scrolled behind, hovered over, or dismissed, it may have a shadow. Static cards, rows, and panels are flat and carry a hairline instead. No element ships with both a 1px border and a wide soft drop shadow as decoration.

rules.name: The Snap-Back Rule
rules.body: Spring overshoot belongs to the wheel alone — its hover nudge and its summon pop, which DESIGN's Overview names as the system's signature motion. Every other transition in the system is an ease or ease-out under 200 ms; a button that bounces is a button that lies about what it is.

dos: Do keep the tonal ramp honest: canvas → panel → card → field must each stay distinguishable from its neighbor, and muted text must clear 4.5:1 on its actual background — verify, don't assume.

Do keep the deeper→lighter order for accent surfaces, and always put white text on the Accent Deep pair for action fills — full Pilot Blue under white text fails AA and is for focus, outputs, and links only.
Do give every interactive control the full state set: default, hover, focus, active, disabled — the toast-with-undo pattern is the model for forgiving, one-step-back feedback.
Do route all icons through Segoe Fluent Icons with the MDL2 fallback, sized to their surface (22px picker / 19px rows / scaled hub).
Do let the wheel preview and the real wheel share one renderer, always.

Do gate every translucent chrome layer on the main-process vibrancy check (<html data-vibrant>) and honor prefers-reduced-transparency by staying solid; verify muted text contrast over the rendered tint, not the token.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the pop and spring degrade to instant or crossfade without losing the affordance.
donts: Don't add glow, neon, or self-drawn acrylic/HUD blur frames anywhere the brand dot isn't — the confirmed anti-reference. The only permitted translucency is the gated DWM acrylic chrome above.
Don't let translucency touch content, floating layers, or the wheel plates — acrylic is chrome, everything the user acts on is solid.
Don't put a drop shadow on static surfaces; borders belong to static cards, shadows to floating layers — not both on one element.
Don't exceed 12px radius on cards, modals, or panels (pills exempt).
Don't introduce a second UI typeface or a display font in any label, button, or data row.
Don't paint empty states or hints in gray so light it drops below AA contrast on the midnight ramp; #8fa3b5 on #161f29 is already the floor.
Don't decorate the wheel — its expression budget is motion and material, not texture or imagery.
